auth.cookieRefused: Tend accepted that, but your browser didn't keep you signed in. Allow cookies for this site. If it has an https address, use that address instead.
problem.title: Something went wrong
offline.title: Can't reach Tend
offline.body: Can't reach Tend. If it runs on this computer, check that its window is still open. If your site is online, check your connection. Then try again.
setup.code.title: Type your setup code
setup.code.intro: It keeps strangers from setting up your site before you do. You'll find it where Tend is running: in its window, or in your host's logs. You can also run: npx tendcms setup-code
setup.code.label: Setup code
setup.code.required: Type the setup code to continue.
setup.password.title: Type your setup password
setup.password.intro: It's the setup password you chose when you created this copy of Tend. You'll only need it once.
setup.password.label: Setup password
setup.password.required: Type the setup password to continue.
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to Tend
setup.welcome.intro: Let's set up your website. It takes about five minutes.
setup.welcome.newHint: Pick a starting design, then write your first page.
setup.welcome.backupHint: Moving a site? Bring everything over from a Tend backup file.
setup.name.title: Name your site
setup.name.label: Site name
setup.name.hint: Visitors see this at the top of every page. You can change it later.
setup.name.required: Type a name for your site. You can change it later.
setup.tagline.label: Tagline (optional)
setup.tagline.hint: A few words about your site, like "Fresh bread every morning".
setup.account.title: Create your account
setup.account.intro: You'll use these to sign in to your site.
setup.account.name: Your name
setup.account.emailRequired: Type your email address, like you@example.com.
setup.account.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A few random words work well.
setup.account.passwordShort: That's too short. Use at least {min} characters.
setup.account.suggested: Save this passphrase somewhere safe, like a password manager. Tend can't show it to you again.
setup.start.title: Pick a starting point
setup.start.intro: This is only where you begin. You can change everything later.
setup.start.blogHint: Posts first, newest at the top.
setup.start.businessHint: A homepage, your hours and how to reach you.
setup.start.blankHint: Nothing yet. Make it your own.
setup.backup.title: Start from a backup
setup.backup.intro: Choose the backup you downloaded from your old site. Everything in it comes over: pages and posts, photos and files, settings, and everyone's accounts.
setup.backup.fileHint: It's the .zip file from Settings → Backups → Download backup on your old site.
setup.backup.notABackup: That isn't a Tend backup. Choose the .zip file you downloaded from Settings → Backups.
setup.backup.sendingBody: Sending your backup: {percent}. Keep this page open.
setup.backup.restoringBody: Checking every file and restoring your site. A big site can take a few minutes, so keep this page open.
login.title: Sign in
login.closedElsewhere: This site is already set up, so what you just typed wasn't saved. Sign in with the account it was set up with.
login.restored: {site} is back, with everything from your backup. Sign in with the email and password you used there.
login.restoredUnnamed: Your site is back, with everything from your backup. Sign in with the email and password you used there.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Ask whoever set up this site for you, or if that was you, run this in your site's folder with your own email:
forgot.after: It shows you a new password and signs your account out everywhere. Recovery codes and emailed links are on the way, but they aren't ready yet.
nav.label: Main
held.notice: Your changes to "{title}" haven't reached your site's server yet. They're kept on this device.
overview.title: Overview
overview.local: Your site is ready on this computer. Only you can see it.
overview.noAddress: Your site is running, but it doesn't have a public address yet, so most people can't reach it.
overview.address.heading: Your site's address
overview.address.body: Your site is now at {address}. Use this address?
overview.address.hint: Links to your pages, your sitemap and previews on social media will all use it. If visitors use a different address, open this page from that one instead.
overview.address.done: Done. Links to your site now use {address}.
status.changes: Changes saved, not on your site yet

pages.title: Pages
list.restored: It's back as a draft. Publish it to put it on your site again.
list.movedToTrash: Moved to the Trash, and taken off your site.
list.empty.post: No posts yet. Write your first one, and it'll appear on your site when you publish it.
list.empty.page: No pages yet. Pages are for things that don't change much, like About or Contact.

editor.page.title: Edit page
editor.addressHint: This will be {address}. If you leave this empty, it comes from the title.
editor.inTrash: This is in the Trash. Restore it to work on it again.
editor.takenOff: Taken off your site. It's a draft now.
editor.heldBack: These changes hadn't reached the server, so they were kept on this device. They're back now.
editor.discardHeld: Go back to the saved version
problem.reload: This screen couldn't load. Anything you typed is kept on this device, so it's safe to try again.
list.confirmDeleteBody: This can't be undone. Links to it from other pages will turn into plain words.
editor.placeholder: Start writing, or type / to add a heading, list, image or button
editor.buttonNoAddress: This button doesn't go anywhere yet.
editor.summaryHint: Shows in lists and when someone shares this. If you leave it empty, it comes from the first paragraph.
editor.offlineKept: Offline. Changes kept on this device
editor.offlineTab: Offline. Your changes are only in this window, so keep it open
editor.signedOut: You've been signed out. Your changes are kept on this device. Sign in to carry on.
editor.discarding: Going back to what's on your site…
editor.conflictYou: You changed this on another device.
editor.conflictKept: Your version has been kept, so choose which one to carry on with.
editor.discarded: Your changes were discarded. This is what's on your site.
editor.versionRestored: That version is back. Publish changes to put it on your site.
editor.duplicated: This is your copy. The original hasn't changed.
editor.leftChanges: Your changes aren't on your site yet.
editor.publishedNow: Published. Your changes are on your site.
paste.table: A table was turned into text, because tables aren't available yet.
paste.image: Pictures from another website were left out. Add them with Insert, then Image.
link.heading: Add a link
link.label: Words on the button
link.labelRequired: Type some words for the button.
link.search: Search your pages, or paste an address
link.badAddress: That doesn't look like an address. Try https://example.com, or pick one of your pages.
publish.heading: Ready to publish?
publish.needsTitle: This needs a title before it can be published.
publish.checks: You might want to look at:
publish.donePost: Your post is on your site.
publish.donePage: Your page is on your site.
check.moved: This moves it from {from} to {to}. The old address will lead to the new one.
check.linkDeleted: A link goes to something that's been deleted, so it will show as plain words.
check.linkNotOnSite: "{title}" isn't on your site, so links to it will show as plain words for now.
check.skippedHeading: A heading skips a level, which makes this harder to follow for people using screen readers.
check.vagueLink: A link just says "{words}". Saying where it goes helps everyone.
check.buttonNoAddress: The "{label}" button doesn't go anywhere yet, so it won't show.
preview.heading: Preview
preview.frame: How this will look on your site
history.heading: History
history.empty: Earlier versions will show here once you've published or kept working for a while.
history.restoreHint: This brings it back as changes to publish. Nothing on your site moves until you do, and what's there now is kept here too.
held.noticeTab: Your changes to "{title}" haven't reached your site's server yet. They're only in this window, so keep it open.
editor.signedOutTab: You've been signed out. Your changes are only in this window, so keep it open and sign in again.
editor.conflictStatus: Not saved. Choose which version to carry on with.
editor.cantGoHere: That can't go there. Try it on an empty line of its own.
editor.deletedHeld: This has been deleted, but you had changes to it that were never saved. They're still on this device.
editor.deletedKeep: Keep them as a new draft
link.found: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing found} one {1 found} other {# found}}
publish.copyFailed: Couldn't copy that. Select the address above and copy it from there.
editor.versionRestoredLive: That version is back. It's already what's on your site.
media.title: Media
media.hint: Photos and PDFs for your site. Drag files onto this page, paste them, or choose them.
media.uploadOffline: Can't reach Tend, so that wasn't uploaded. Check your connection, then try again.
media.uploadStalled: That file stopped arriving partway through, so it wasn't uploaded. Check your connection, then try again.
media.tooBig: That file is bigger than 20 MB, which is the most Tend can take. Make it smaller first. For a photo, export it at a smaller size or as a JPEG.
media.empty: Nothing here yet. Add photos and PDFs, and they'll be ready to use on any page.
media.noMatches: Nothing matches that. Try another word.
media.saved: Saved. It's changed everywhere this is used.
media.trashedLive: {count, plural, one {Moved to the Trash, and taken off # page of your site.} other {Moved to the Trash, and taken off # pages of your site.}}
media.trashedSite: Your site no longer uses it as its {uses}.
media.trashedLinks: It's still linked from {places}, but {links, plural, one {that link leads} other {those links lead}} nowhere until you restore it.
media.linkedPages: {count, plural, one {# page of your site} other {# pages of your site}}
media.replaced: Replaced. Every page using it shows the new one.
media.descriptionHint: Describe this image for people who can't see it. Changing it here changes it everywhere it's used.
media.creditExample: For example: Photo by Sam Lee
image.uploadStopped: This upload stopped before it finished. Remove it, then add the picture again.
image.cantLoad: Can't load this picture right now. Check your connection, then reload the page.
image.deleted: This picture was deleted, so it won't show on your site.
image.inTrash: {name} is in the Trash, so it won't show on your site. Restore it in Media, or remove it here.
image.caption: Caption
picker.heading: Add an image
picker.search: Or choose one already in Media
picker.empty: Nothing in Media yet. Upload one above.
alt.heading: Describe this image
alt.hint: For people who can't see it, and for search engines. Say what's in it that matters here, like "A loaf of sourdough on a wooden board".
featured.label: Featured image
featured.automatic: Automatic: the first image in the text is used, if there is one.
featured.inTrash: This image is in the Trash, so it isn't shown. Restore it in Media, or choose another.
featured.gone: That image was deleted. Choose another, or go back to automatic.
featured.heading: Choose the featured image
tags.label: Tags
tags.hint: Words that group posts together, like Recipes or Events. Each tag gets its own page.
search.title: Title in search results
search.titleHint: Leave it empty to use the title.
search.descriptionHint: Leave it empty to use the summary.
search.noindex: Ask search engines not to show this
check.noDescription: {count, plural, one {1 image has no description, so people who can't see it won't know what it shows.} other {# images have no description, so people who can't see them won't know what they show.}}
check.pictureGone: {count, plural, one {1 image is in the Trash or deleted, so it won't show.} other {# images are in the Trash or deleted, so they won't show.}}
publish.showInMenuHint: Adds a link to it at the end of the menu at the top of every page.
menu.title: Site menu
menu.hint: The links at the top and bottom of every page.
menu.automatic: For now, this menu has every published page, plus Blog once you have posts. Change anything and save, and it becomes yours to arrange.
menu.footerEmpty: Nothing in the footer menu yet. Add links like Privacy or Contact.
menu.notShown: Not on your site right now, so visitors don't see this link.
menu.search: Search your pages, posts and tags, or paste an address
menu.undone: The menu is back as it was.
menu.outdented: "{title}" is back at the top level.
design.title: Design
design.hint: How your site looks. Nothing changes on it until you save.
design.logoHint: Shown at the top of every page instead of your site's name. A wide PNG with a see-through background works best.
design.noLogo: No logo: your site's name is shown instead.
design.iconHint: The little picture in browser tabs and on phone home screens. A square picture works best.
design.noIcon: None yet. Add a logo, or choose a picture.
design.lowContrast: Hard to read on white. Use {color} instead?
design.lowContrastSoft: Hard to read in sections with a Soft background. Use {color} instead?
design.socialHint: Shown at the bottom of every page.
design.cssHint: For people who know CSS. It may stop working when the theme is updated, and a mistake here can make your site hard to read.
design.undone: The design is back as it was.
settings.title: Settings
backups.download.heading: Download a backup
backups.download.body: One zip file with everything on your site: its pages and posts, settings, photos and files. Keep it somewhere safe, away from this server. To move your site, choose Start from a backup when you set up the new one.
backups.download.private: Keep this file private. It holds everyone's sign-in details too, so anyone who has it can make a copy of your site.
backups.download.ownerOnly: Only the Owner can download a backup, because it holds everyone's sign-in details.
backups.download.never: No backup has been downloaded yet.
backups.disk.heading: Space on this server
backups.disk.low: Space is running low. Remove photos and files you no longer need from Media, or ask your host for more.
backups.disk.veryLow: Space has nearly run out, and when it does your changes can't be saved. Remove photos and files you no longer need from Media, or ask your host for more.
backups.copies.heading: Copies kept on this server
backups.copies.body: Each day at 3 in the morning, Tend saves a copy of your pages, posts and settings here, and it saves one before each update too. It keeps a week of daily copies and four weekly ones. Photos and files aren't in these copies: a downloaded backup has everything. Anything you delete from Media stays on this server for up to six weeks, so these copies can still show it, or less if space runs low.
backups.copies.none: There are no copies yet. The first is saved at 3 in the morning.
settings.taglineHint: A few words under your site's name, like "Fresh bread every morning".
settings.visibility.publicHint: Your site is open to anyone, and search engines can find it.
settings.visibility.coming_soonHint: Visitors see a Coming soon page with your name and details. You still see the real site while you're signed in.
settings.visibility.privateHint: Visitors are asked to sign in. Pictures and files can still be opened by anyone who has their address.
business.hint: Type these once: they show at the bottom of every page, and in any Contact & hours section.
business.mapHint: Paste the link from Google Maps or Apple Maps, for "Get directions".
business.noteExample: For example: Closed on public holidays
seo.homeDescriptionHint: Shown under your site's name in search results. Leave it empty to use your tagline.
seo.imageHint: Shown when someone shares a page that has no picture of its own.
redirects.heading: Redirects
redirects.hint: When a page's address changes, Tend sends the old address to the new one by itself. Add your own here, for example for addresses from an old website.
redirects.auto: Made by Tend · used {hits, plural, one {once} other {# times}}
redirects.manual: Added by hand · used {hits, plural, one {once} other {# times}}
redirects.fromHint: Like /old-page, or a whole address from your old site.
code.heading: Add code to every page
code.warning: For things like a visitor counter or a site check. Only paste code from a company you trust: it can do anything on your site. It's left out of previews.
code.head: In the head of every page
code.bodyEnd: At the end of every page
editor.contactDetails: Your business details show here: address, phone, email, a map link and opening hours. They're the same everywhere on your site.
editor.contactEdit: Change the business details (opens in a new tab)
overview.business: Add your business details: address, phone and opening hours
overview.logo: Add your logo and choose colours
overview.backup.heading: Download a backup
overview.backup.never: You haven't downloaded a backup of your site yet. Keep one somewhere safe, away from this server.
overview.backup.since: You last downloaded a backup on {date}. Download a new one, so it has everything you've added since.
editor.takenOffMenu: Taken off your site, and out of the site menu. It's a draft now.
